subject: VP/CTO intro to align on architecture and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Lee <michael.lee@acmeapps.com>, Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acmeapps.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — next steps / VP-CTO intro

Thanks again for your time this morning — great conversation and clear product fit. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key needs we heard: lower-latency inference for user-facing features, predictable costing for heavy embedding workloads, and audit logging for data retention requirements.
- Immediate ask from your side: executive alignment with your CTO (Sarah) to confirm architecture constraints and unblock procurement.
- Recommended next step from our side: 30-min VP/CTO alignment (product + architecture) followed by a 60-min technical deep dive with our Solutions Engineer to map integration details.

Proposed times (all PT):
- Wed 2026-07-22 11:00–11:30
- Thu 2026-07-23 14:00–14:30

If either works for you and Sarah, I can send a calendar invite and include Vivek (VP Product) and Monica (SE) for the technical portion. I attached the call notes and a one-page mutual action plan for reference.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- 20260715-acme-discovery-notes.pdf (notes)
- acme-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (mutual action plan)

From: Michael Lee <michael.lee@acmeapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acmeapps.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — next steps / VP-CTO intro

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Agree on the ask and appreciate the summary. Sarah and I are aligned that an exec-level alignment would be helpful before we commit to procurement.

Wed 7/22 11:00 PT looks good from our side. If possible, we’d like the meeting to be 30 minutes: high-level architecture constraints and go/no-go signals for our security and infra team. Then we’ll follow with a technical deep dive where Monica can walk through compatibility and integration.

I’ll lead the architecture portion and summarize where we can offer constrained-latency routing and dedicated capacity options. Monica, can you please be on the follow-up technical deep dive (60 min)? Nikhil, please prep a short note on data retention/audit logging we can surface in the call.

I’ll send a calendar invite now with the agenda and call link; Marissa — please add the mutual action plan to the invite.
